free_tier.stated: No file storage: limits are 500000 rows and 24 columns per table and 1kb per cell (open-beta limits), about 12 GB of cell data per table at most; the docs say to store pointers to IPFS, Filecoin or Arweave instead.

egress.terms: Reads go through an unauthenticated REST call to a gateway; no meter is stated.

limits_note: Mutating queries are onchain operations paying the chain's gas; query size is limited to 35kb (14.5kb on Ethereum mainnet).
